maria (AE): Heads-up — LargeBank is asking for a colocated POC in their COLO (no egress). They want to validate patch/upgrade cadence, bundle signing, and cost for a 3-month pilot. Can we clarify constraints?

alex (SE): Good call. Main questions: how big are bundles, how do we deliver deltas, and what's our recommended upgrade window for air-gapped sites?

maria (AE): They also asked about the legal side: do we require an SLA for the pilot or can we do a limited SOW with ops support?

devon (Solutions Eng): For sizing: typical airgap bundle ~2.2GB for quantized runtime + models, but depends on model. We can produce a trimmed bundle (model selection + no docs) to get it under ~1.1GB.

alex (SE): Re: deltas — we have a chunked bundle format that supports delta patches, but customer firewall rules may force USB or Sneakernet. If using delta patches over a controlled jumpbox, we can drop delta size to ~150–300MB.

sarah (Security): From Sec's perspective: must sign bundles with our release key and include SBOM. They want to verify chain-of-custody. We should provide instructions for verifying signature locally:

sarah (Security): ```
# on customer jumpbox
sha256sum redwood-bundle-v1.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood-release.pub -signature redwood-bundle-v1.sig redwood-bundle-v1.tar.gz
```

tim (Infra): Important: offline installs require pre-provisioned entitlements (license token) and certificate pinning. Certificate rotation is manual in air-gapped mode — recommend quarterly rotation in the SOW.

maria (AE): Is quarterly cert rotation acceptable? Customer asked for less frequent (6–12 months) due to operational constraints.

sarah (Security): We can relax if they accept a compensating control: HSM/KMS custody for the jumpbox private key or limit admin access and provide audit scripts. With that we can go to 6 months, not 12.

alex (SE): Upgrade cadence: for pilot we suggest monthly maintenance bundles (security + bug fixes) and one major upgrade window mid-pilot. We can do emergency hotfixes as signed patches outside cadence.

devon (Solutions Eng): Ops note: we'll include a lightweight validation runbook (checksums, service health endpoints). Example health check: `curl --unix-socket /var/run/redwood.sock http://localhost/health`

maria (AE): Pricing ask — they want committed pricing for the 3-month pilot (dedicated seat + offline delivery). Any rough numbers?

tim (Infra): From Commercial — pilot pricing is typically a one-time packaging & secure-delivery fee + monthly reserved capacity. Rough numbers: $15k packaging + $10k/month reserved for pilot size. I'll confirm legal input.

maria (AE): OK noted. I will share those ballpark numbers and the security caveats. Can someone draft a short SOW snippet for the pilot that includes: bundle signing, quarterly cert rotation (or 6mo with KMS), delta patch method, delivery options (jumpbox USB), and pricing line items?

alex (SE): I can draft the SOW snippet. Quick Q: do we need to list supported OS images for the jumpbox? Customer runs RHEL8.

sarah (Security): Yes list supported images + minimum kernel version and FIPS requirements. Add requirement: jumpbox locked down to allow only specific CIDR or direct USB ingestion.

deploy-bot: bundle-signing-service: new signed-bundle redwood-bundle-v1.sig created (sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924).

maria (AE): Thanks. Let's aim to send the SOW draft and the security checklist by EOD tomorrow and propose a call with LargeBank for Thursday. :thumbsup:

alex (SE): On it — will drop a draft here later today.

devon (Solutions Eng): I'll attach the runbook checklist when Alex posts the SOW.

sarah (Security): I'll add the signature verification steps + KMS options.

maria (AE): Great team, appreciate the quick turnaround.
